messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY ALERT - metrics-pipeline-prod - Prometheus scrape failures high for 5m (rule: prometheus_scrape_failures_ratio > 0.5). Paging @eng-sre oncall. Incident ID: PD-76821 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident PD-76821 created and triggered to channel. Link: https://pd.example/PD-76821 :page_with_curl:

jordan: ack. I'm on it, looking at scrape job health and kafka ingest metrics.

priya: thx — i'm nearby if you want a hand. quick q: is this scrape failure only from prometheus-k8s or also remote_write?

jordan: initial glance: prometheus-k8s scrape job 'node-exporter' showing ~60% target failures across clusters. remote_write seems ok but log-ingest consumer lag has crept up ~20k msgs. going to check prometheus pods and scrape-exporter logs.

lucas: :eyes: could be exporter OOMs again. saw similar pattern last month where node-exporter started dropping on high churn. check kube events for evictions.

jordan: running commands:
```bash
# list prometheus pods
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=prometheus -o wide
# check exporter logs
kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-scrape-exporter-0 -c exporter --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

jordan: logs show repeated "error scraping target" with TLS handshake timeouts and a few "connection reset by peer". exporter memory ~270Mi, limit 300Mi. heap creeping.

sam: I'm taking on-call at 03:00 UTC but can help now. Propose: 1) scale scrape-exporter replicas to 4 temporarily, 2) pin remove noisy targets via prometheus relabel, 3) route critical dashboards to backup read-replica. Thoughts?

priya: +1 to scaling. For noisy targets, can we mute targets from the cloud provider metadata endpoint for 15m? quick relabel could be risky.

jordan: scaling now: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment prometheus-scrape-exporter --replicas=4` -> rolled out. Also bumped exporter memory limit to 512Mi with a quick patch to avoid OOM.

incident-bot: Action logged: scaled prometheus-scrape-exporter -> 4 replicas. Patch applied to exporter resource limits.

lucas: after scaling, scrape failure ratio dropped to ~18% over the last 2m. kafka consumer lag still elevated, looks like writes were backpressured earlier and backlog is draining.

jordan: customer impact: dashboards served from metrics-read-replica (downgraded) saw staleness ~10-20m for some customers; alerting suppressed during page spike but some internal SLO dashboards were stale. Not a total outage but degraded read freshness.

priya: logging pipeline: ingestion lag spike correlated — checking ingress nodes for 503s. If remote_write was busy, some exporters might have retried and caused burst.

jordan: mitigations so far: scaled exporters, bumped memory, temporarily disabled non-critical cloud metadata endpoints (targets) via relabel, restarted two prometheus scrape instances to clear hung connections. Observing.

sam: thanks. I'm going to hand off to Priya in 20m before my window starts. Priya, want to take over monitoring for the next 40m and handle customer comms? I can join if needed. :handshake:

priya: taking handoff. I'll post a short status update to #incidents and notify CS. Current status: degradations reduced, scrape failures ~12% and trending down, kafka consumer lag decreasing. Customers may have had up to 20m of stale metrics; no data loss confirmed, just backlog.

pagerduty: PD-76821 acknowledged by jordan. Escalation to SRE lead not required.

jordan: adding note for postmortem: check exporter memory/cgroup settings, introduce readiness probe to fail fast on TLS handshake spikes, and add per-target backoff to exporter. Also add an alert for exporter OOM/kube evictions.

priya: will coordinate customer notification draft: short message explaining degraded metric freshness and that ingest backlog is being drained; estimate full catch-up in ~30-45m. Will ping CS for approvals.

lucas: quick follow-up check: `kubectl get events -n monitoring --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50` shows a few node kernel OOM_killer logs earlier for two exporter pods — we'll include that in the PM.

incident-bot: NOTE: Page closed? Not automatically. Please mark PD incident resolved when safe.

priya: marking as status=monitoring. will resolve PD once backlog is under 5k and scrape_failures < 2% for 10m.

jordan: agreed. leaving a runbook step: if backlog not drained in 60m, failover reads to metrics-read-replica permanently for affected customers and open a Jira to rollback problematic target changes.

priya: thanks team. I'll update again in 15m. :thumbsup:
